task_evaluations.name: Categorical Encoding
task_evaluations.prompt: Encode categorical variables for machine learning including ordinal, nominal, and high-cardinality cases.
task_evaluations.expected_behavior: The skill should provide encoding strategies, implementation patterns, and selection guidance.

task_evaluations.name: Feature Scaling
task_evaluations.prompt: Apply appropriate scaling and transformations to numeric features for different model types.
task_evaluations.expected_behavior: The skill should explain scaling methods, when to use each, and implementation patterns.

task_evaluations.name: Datetime Features
task_evaluations.prompt: Engineer features from datetime columns including cyclical encoding, time since events, and seasonality.
task_evaluations.expected_behavior: The skill should provide datetime extraction patterns, cyclical encoding, and feature creation.

task_evaluations.name: Text Features
task_evaluations.prompt: Extract features from text data using TF-IDF, embeddings, and other NLP techniques.
task_evaluations.expected_behavior: The skill should explain text feature extraction methods and implementation patterns.

task_evaluations.name: Leakage-Safe Pipeline
task_evaluations.prompt: Build a feature engineering pipeline that prevents data leakage using proper cross-validation and transformation sequencing.
task_evaluations.expected_behavior: The skill should explain leakage risks and provide safe pipeline patterns.
